name: Hanahime * Absolute!
original_name: ハナヒメ＊アブソリュート！
source:
In 2025, the social game Crown Hearts about the battle between the princes' country ‘Stella Crown’ and the princesses’ country ‘Floris Hearts’ was a smash hit, and pro gamers have become as popular as star athletes. Koharu attends Luminus Academy with his pure osananajimi and hopeful new pro gamer Maher, kind and slightly brocon imouto Hiyoko, and Hiyoko’s friend and extremely popular net idol Ayane.

One day, they attended the opening ceremony of the annual Crown Hearts event “Divine Crown Battle”. However, this year, they announced the new “Crown Hearts VR”, where one may battle others in the real world using the latest in virtual reality technology. Sixteen entrants were chosen for the “Divine Crown Battle VR” tournament: a ‘king’ and his seven ‘flower princesses’, and a ‘queen’ and her seven ‘star princes’.

Koharu was chosen as the king by the AI girl Polina, who appeared out from the Crown Hearts world. He must battle in the tournament alongside the sword princess Maher, love princess Hinako and many others. It was rumoured that the winner would have his or her wish granted. Are you ready for this new generation battle royale!?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/05/01/may-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
2025年，以王子之国“星冠”和公主之国“花心”之间战争为主题的社交游戏《王冠之心》大获成功，职业玩家变得像明星运动员一样受欢迎。小春就读于光辉学园，与纯真的青梅竹马、未来职业玩家马赫，温柔而略带兄控属性的妹妹雏子，以及雏子的朋友、极受欢迎的网络偶像绫音一起生活。

一天，他们参加了年度《王冠之心》活动“神圣王冠战”的开幕式。然而，今年官方宣布了新作“王冠之心VR”，可以利用最新虚拟现实技术在现实世界与他人战斗。共有16名选手入选“神圣王冠战VR”大赛：一名“国王”和他的七位“花公主”，以及一名“女王”和她的七位“星王子”。

从《王冠之心》世界中现身的AI女孩波莉娜选择小春成为国王。他必须与剑公主马赫、爱公主雏子等人并肩参加比赛。据说获胜者能实现一个愿望。准备好迎接新世代大逃杀了吗？

[译自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/05/01/may-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
